reviews.snippet:
I recently had my delivery at Cloudnine Hospital, Jayanagar, and overall, I had a good experience. The doctors, nurses, staff, and the facilities were up to the mark, and I felt well taken care of throughout my stay. I’m grateful to the entire team for their support during such an important phase of my life.
However, I feel there are a couple of areas where the hospital could improve. The food charges were around ₹3,000 for 3 days, but considering the quantity and quality provided, I felt the pricing was quite high and not completely justified. The quantity could definitely be improved for the price being charged.
Also, the photography services offered by the hospital felt a little expensive compared to the prices available outside for similar services.
Overall, I had a positive experience with the medical care and hospital facilities, but I hope the hospital considers reviewing the pricing and value provided for food and photography services. This would make the overall experience even better for new parents.

reviews.snippet:
***********New SCAM UNLOCKED @ Cloudnine Jayanagar *************

I was cheated at the hospital about billing that my wife has undergone for a simple D&C procedure.
I was informed that the procedure will cost around 30K + pharmacy around 5K to 10K which will come around 45K as an overall amount.
But when I check the final break-up statement, that has literally blown my mind.

Literally, hospital has got 30K from insurance (TPA) + 32,181/- from my end total amount = 62,181/-

I want to understand here what is the use of taking packages at a hospital, when items used for doing so are separately billed to customers which is included procedure charges mixed under pharmaceutical??

Worst part of the scam is :-  Hospital will share only package invoice to insurance, & get that approved, they won't share entire itemized bill that provided to customer.

Explanation I got from hospital :- I will try to explain it by taking an simple example (Tour Package)

If we opt for a tour package, they initially informed me that it will cover Travel, food, accommodation.

When the journey started, I’ve to pay extra for fuel, toll fee, food, & accommodation.

When I questioned back, the reply I got was “package will include only reserving seats in the vehicle”, rest everything is extra.

Below are the major billing products I am mentioning from the break-up invoice I’ve paid from my pocket.

Pharmacy :- 16,000/-

1. anaesthesia breathing circuit
2. D&C Pack
3. LMA Supreme 1.5
4. Yankauer Suction Set

Radiology :-
Ultrasound Guided procedure :- 2,640/-
KUB Ultrasound Adult :- 1,980/-

It's not only me who got cheated alone, with me I saw one more delivery case where they intimated 1 lakh 75k as package but he ended up paying 2 lakh 75k.
In his case he has been charged for attender bed charges 8k separately.....

During admission time I even noticed one parent complaining about emergency ward that no staff to take care of their children.... Worst hospital & worst experience.

reviews.snippet:
We received nothing short of funtastic service! We are overjoyed and blessed with the arrival of our baby boy, and we extend our deepest gratitude for the meticulous care and exemplary emergency response.
Yes, it is an expensive investment, but it is unequivocally worth every rupee. I even debated dropping a few services, specifically the lactation consultation, but I would now strongly urge everyone to opt into all included package services. Their lactation team is unparalleled. Furthermore, the nurses are highly experienced—the way they confidently and gently handle a half-day-old infant is a true testament to their expertise.
For anyone searching for a delivery hospital, look no further than Cloud9. Having seen Rainbow and Motherhood (for other reasons), I truly believe Cloud9 stands out as the best. This particular branch is phenomenal. It felt less like a hospital and more like a luxurious 5-star hotel. If we are blessed with a second child, this will be our only choice!
Special thanks to Lapin sister (nurse) & valli sister(lactation)

reviews.snippet:
We consulted Dr. Kini and were extremely happy with the treatment provided. Before meeting him, we had consulted at least 12 senior doctors across Bangalore and Mumbai, but the conviction and clarity Dr. Kini had was truly reassuring. His confidence and approach gave us complete peace of mind throughout the journey.

The entire experience — right from the initial consultation through to the delivery, spanning almost a year — was very rewarding. The hospital has a great team of professionals who ensured we were well taken care of at every stage. The processes are organized, smooth, and well-coordinated, making the whole journey comfortable and stress-free.

A special mention to Sister Prascila, Dr. Valli, Dr. Rekha, Dr. Surekha, Dr. Namitha, and Dr. Kishore — each of them was outstanding in their care, support, and professionalism.

A heartfelt thank you to Dr. Kini and the entire Cloud 9 Jayanagar team for making this such a positive and memorable experience.

Doctors write too costly medicines and they usually are only available at some outlets.

The cost of the delivery varies from insurance company to insurance company and irrespective of insurance company coverage you have to pay the same amount as balance.

Unnecessary costs are put in the bill and they argue that the cost is as per package

Nurses and Doctors coordination not there , nurses don’t tell sometimes to doctors about the patients. Some times nurses forget to give the medicine that would have been said till patient start feeling discomfort and call doctors.

Suggests all looking for being new parents or having another kid to see other hospitals like Fortis , Apollo, Motherhood or any near good hospital.

Food is also too costly for attenders with parents and taste is  worse.
